data.long_meaning: The name Firhad is of Arabic origin, meaning 'Brave Lion'. It is derived from the Arabic words 'Fir' meaning 'lion' and 'Had' meaning 'brave' or 'courageous'. This name is perfect for a little boy who embodies strength, courage and the spirit of a warrior. The name Firhad carries the meaning “Brave Lion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Firhad usually hope their child will grow to embody brave lion and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Context: Persian Empire
